subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should `artifacts.download` permanently expose session-bound managed outgoing image bytes only to `operator.admin`, with older or non-RPC paths relying on the existing authenticated media route?
rationale: The code changes the durable authorization boundary for local managed-image bytes; source inspection establishes the mechanics but cannot determine the repository's intended operator-scope policy.

options.title: Confirm admin-only RPC bytes
options.body: Keep the proposed scope boundary, require current-head allowed and denied proof, and document the version-skew fallback as the supported behavior.

options.title: Use only the existing media authorization path
options.body: Remove the privileged artifact-byte route and make the workspace use the established authenticated media fetch path for all compatible Gateways.

options.title: Define a broader artifact-read contract
options.body: Choose and document a different stable authorization scope before implementing it with compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Confirm admin-only RPC bytes
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed scope boundary, require current-head allowed and denied proof, and document the version-skew fallback as the supported behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Timeline evidence associates this reviewer with the earlier protected-media authorization discussion.
